objectMovedHtml._provenance: The literal BSE redirect-page body already used as the real captured shape in scraper/tests/unit/services/document-discovery-runner-download.test.ts (T-403 M4/F2 fixtures) -- reused verbatim here rather than retyped, so this golden and that test agree on what BSE actually serves.

pdfGap: No full real RHP/DRHP PDF byte content is checked into this repo (only page-text extractions under scraper/tests/fixtures/extractor/ and *.ocr.pages.json). This stage's PDF-acceptance and sha256-dedup cases therefore use a structurally-real PDF buffer (starts with the %PDF magic, over the MIN_DOCUMENT_BYTES floor) -- the same approach document-download-verifier.test.ts and document-discovery-runner-download.test.ts already take for this exact reason. This is a stated gap, not an invented fixture: the byte CONTENT is synthetic filler, only the shape (magic bytes + size) is asserted.
